description: Phase 3 runtime activation (216 rules): 211 vendor rules plus the generic rules jwt, jwt-base64 and private-key, plus the path-scoped rule kubernetes-secret-yaml, plus the legacy high-entropy-assignment detector. Every activated rule catches its upstream corpus true-positives with zero same-rule false positives (measured). Excluded with rationale (see docs/adr/0016): generic-api-key (3/63 in-process, FP-prone — legacy high-entropy-assignment keeps the coverage), curl-auth-header/curl-auth-user (corpus false positives, no reproducible allowlist guard), freemius-secret-key/hashicorp-tf-password/nuget-config-password (path-scoped: upstream's path filter is a false-positive guard body scanning cannot reproduce, and each fires on its upstream fp samples), pkcs12-file (path-only, no body content). private-key aliases private-key-block for attestation continuity; the legacy jwt/private-key-block detectors are superseded by upstream jwt/jwt-base64/private-key.

localRules.description: Legacy Hamza high-entropy assignment detector. Retained in Phase 3 in place of the upstream generic-api-key rule (see docs/adr/0016): in-process, generic-api-key catches only 3/63 of its upstream samples without a secretGroup override and is the ruleset's most false-positive-prone rule, so the proven legacy detector keeps the generic-assignment coverage. The secret span is capture group 2.
